name: screenshot-inline-menus
integration: Append only inlineMenus to the build manifest before font collection. This file is not a compileTextDraft input.
validationNotes: The source-reference draft begins after the eight-byte menu header. Relocate the complete header as well as the labels; its 38 control stores a three-byte native callback address.
The original wrappers at 0x84e768 and 0x84e7a2 load the full menu addresses into direct-page b9..bb, then call 0x84afb8. No alternate full-menu loader was found in the original ROM.
Keep the long callback addresses 98e784 and f9e784 unchanged. Their code remains in bank 84, outside the relocated data spans; there is no trailing per-choice callback table in these two menus.

Karura callback 0x84e798 copies one-based selection 0x12e4 to 0x1957 (1, 2, 3). Shuten callback 0x84e7f9 uses one-based selection 0x12e4 as an index into 0x84e817, writes opponent ID 04/86/8b/88 to 0x195f + slot 0x1964, and sets the corresponding bit in 0x1986.
Preserve the Shuten 25 86 19 mask controls, 21 3e selector markers, 01 2c separators and final 00 exactly. No indexedNames are included.

With two-byte Chinese glyph encoding the allocations are [0x23de00,0x23de24) (36 bytes) and [0x23df00,0x23df45) (69 bytes). Existing travel-destinations ends at 0x23dce4. The builder must still enforce collision checks against the final manifest.
Both native headers contain 37, which sets 0x1380 bit 80 and disables cancellation. B must leave the menu active without executing the outcome callback; subsequent A must still select normally.

Run tools/verify-screenshot-inline-menus.mjs RUNNER CORE PREVIEW NEW_OUTPUT [FIELD_STATE] against the exact final build. It uses isolated synthetic ROM copies and native event wrappers, checks rendered labels, every selector and outcome, Shuten excluded-row mask 05, ignored cancellation and callback timing against the Japanese ROM. It does not certify subsequent story dialogue or opponent battle events. Successful runs retain verification.json and open/cancel screenshots only; set MOMOTARO_KEEP_INLINE_CAPTURES=1 to retain all ROM copies, states and snapshots.
